detail: The first independent replay keyed all 232 reference rows by schedule row hash, but the registered manifest keys A1 truth by case-unit hash and A2 truth by row hash. The audit stopped with PRIVATE_TRUTH_DIGEST_MISMATCH before writing a passing report. Corrected the independent key reconstruction, then verified all 40 frozen inputs, nine source bindings, private source hashes, and the private truth digest; no model/API calls occurred.

One combined audit/runner test invocation had two fake-server loopback tests fail with Windows WinError 10013 while binding or connecting to localhost; the same unchanged focused suite passed on a later default-sandbox run (22 passed). No code or experiment data changed in response, and no provider/model requests occurred.

The first independent sensitivity calculation selected one arbitrary response from a repeated Public-only/Neutral input-pair profile. The profile's two transitions differed. Updated the auditor to mark the cluster unstable and exclude it only from the preregistered descriptive unique-profile sensitivity; all 24 assigned rows remain in primary analysis. Added a regression test; no model calls or source-data changes occurred.

A counterexample test using a small synthetic transition fixture failed because the audit helper assumed a fixed population of 24. Parameterized expected case count for unit fixtures while retaining the production schedule count check; added a passing regression test. No campaign output or denominator changed.

The hash-only ledger cost test expected USD 0.0000009, but independent token-rate arithmetic for the fixture yields USD 0.000211500. Corrected the test expectation to the calculated value; production ledger cost and campaign results were not modified.

A one-off postrun text-analysis command failed to decode a UTF-8 source under the Windows default GBK encoding. Reran with explicit UTF-8 and completed the sanitized analysis; no source artifact or model request changed.

After the final audit/test fixes, reran raw replay and both campaign-focused audit/runner test modules. Independent raw replay passed for 232/232 attempted requests; pytest reported 27 passed in 25.53 seconds. Complete outputs are retained in campaign-postrun-independent-audit-final.log and campaign-postrun-focused-tests-rerun.log. Zero additional model/API requests occurred.

Researchctl audit found that post-close appends had changed failure_history.jsonl, whose original bytes are hash-pinned by the earlier matched-world closure. Preserved every appended line in campaign-postrun-failure-history-addendum.jsonl, restored the prior file byte-for-byte from HEAD, and updated only the new campaign closure output references. The old closure and its result were not modified.

After restoring the earlier hash-pinned failure_history.jsonl, the first closeout audit also exposed two references in the new closure to the pre-correction evidence-report hash. Updated only those hashes to the finalized report bytes; no experiment evidence, labels, calls, or prior closure changed.

After the new cycle was closed, researchctl audit detected that research/memory.json had not yet been rebuilt from the closed cycle. Ran researchctl sync-memory, then audit passed. No closure result or experiment artifact changed.
